verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, so a buyer can fairly ask whether it discloses how AI is used in petition drafting and review. However, none of its pages in the evidence mention AI, automation, or a split between automated work and attorney review. The pages cover only practice areas, visa types, and consultation offers.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
